title: CI Governance Policy — Architectural Compliance
description: Policies governing architectural CI/CD integration and static conformance validation

policies.name: Structural Conformance
policies.description: Every .js file in backend/src/core/ must follow strict structural rules
rules: Every .js file (except index.js and *.test.js) must export exactly one class via module.exports = ClassName
Class name must match filename in PascalCase (e.g., FooBar.js exports class FooBar)
Every exported class must have constructor(constitutionManager) or constructor(options = {})
Every exported class must have getStatus() method returning object with timestamp
Orchestrator classes must have generateReport() method
No file may exceed 450 lines including comments
index.js files in modules are exempt from single-class rule and may contain multiple exports

policies.name: Dependency Audit
policies.description: All local require() calls must match declared dependencies in ROOT_CONSTITUTION/dependency-rules/DependencyRules.json
rules: Every local require('./path') must be declared in DependencyRules matrix
No circular dependencies permitted at any level
New layers (PHASE 1.3+) may depend on Phase 1.2 components, never the reverse

policies.name: Pipeline Determinism
policies.description: CI pipeline execution must be fully deterministic and reproducible
rules: Pipeline stages must execute in declared order: LOAD_CONSTITUTION → VERIFY_INTEGRITY → ANALYZE_CONFORMANCE → AUDIT_DEPENDENCIES → COLLECT_RESULTS
Exit code 0 = all checks pass, exit code 1 = any failure
Reports must be generated in all 3 formats: JSON (structured), Markdown (human), JUnit XML (tool-compatible)
Pipeline must complete in < 60 seconds on typical codebase

CRITICAL.description: Fail the CI pipeline with exit code 1

HIGH.description: Fail the CI pipeline with exit code 1

MEDIUM.description: Log warning, continue pipeline with exit code 0

LOW.description: Log info message, continue pipeline with exit code 0

naming_conventions.description: Verify PascalCase class names match filename

required_methods.description: Verify getStatus() and optionally generateReport() methods

line_count_limit.description: Verify files do not exceed 450 lines

dependency_audit.description: Audit local require() calls against DependencyRules matrix
